title: Canon Ontology Response
description: Expected shape returned by canon.chitty.cc/api/ontology. Used by chittyschema's canon-client to validate responses before caching them. The fallback hardcoded P/L/T/E/A list also conforms to this shape.

version.description: Version identifier for this ontology snapshot. SHOULD be semver but the fallback uses 'fallback-0.0.0'.

source.description: Where the snapshot came from. Set by chittyschema's canon-client; canon should return 'live'.

types.description: Canonical entity types. MUST include all five P/L/T/E/A core types per chittycanon://gov/governance.

code.description: Short type code. The five core codes are P/L/T/E/A; canon may add subtype codes in future.

subtypes.description: Optional sub-classification (e.g. for Person: Natural / Synthetic / Legal).
